# proxmox_node_ceph_osd_lv_info (Data Source)

Reads OSD LV info from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/osd/{osdid}/lv-info`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_osd_lv_info" "l" {
  node  = "pve-1"
  osdid = 0
  type  = "block"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `osdid` (Number)
- `type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `info` (String)
